rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for actively allowing or indulging wrongdoing, and it can also mean overlooking it.

example.english: We must not condone employees deceiving customers.
example.traditional: 我哋唔可以縱容員工呃客。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 m4 ho2 ji5 zung3 jung4 jyun4 gung1 ngaak1 haak3

rows.note: Use this for the forgiveness or excusing side of condoning rather than for permitting the wrongdoing to continue.

example.english: I can condone your lie this time, but you have to tell the truth.
example.traditional: 我可以原諒你今次講大話，但你要講返真話。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ho2 ji5 jyun4 loeng6 nei5 gam1 ci3 gong2 daai6 waa6 daan6 nei5 jiu3 gong2 faan2 zan1 waa6

rows.note: Use this casual construction when someone simply lets another person do something wrong without stopping them.

example.english: They condone their son bullying classmates at school.
example.traditional: 佢哋由得個仔喺學校蝦人。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 jau4 dak1 go3 zai2 hai2 hok6 haau6 haa1 jan4
